svg.title: Unified data platform — layered architecture
svg.desc: One shared lake underneath; every workload sits at its own height above it. SYNTHETIC illustration of a Fabric-like platform. Generic names, no logos; not a vendor reference architecture or a real tenant.
svg.text: One shared lake underneath; every workload sits at its own height above it.

g.title: ERP database → Nightly copy: Changed rows
Nightly copy → Sales lakehouse: Land raw
Sales lakehouse → Cleaning notebook: Read raw
Cleaning notebook → Sales warehouse: Write gold
Sales warehouse → Sales model: Star schema
Sales warehouse → Query endpoint: Query
Sales model → Revenue report: Measures
Query endpoint → Partner web app: JSON
Plant sensors → Sensor stream: Readings
Sensor stream → Telemetry store: Ingest
Telemetry store → Live dashboard: Live query
Telemetry store → Threshold alert: Watch
Revenue report → Analysts: Read
Live dashboard → Operators: Watch
Threshold alert → Operators: Notify
Workspace identity → Query endpoint: Authorize
Workspace identity → Revenue report: Sign in
Shared lake: Single storage layer for every workspace. Tables are kept once as open columnar (Delta/Parquet) files; each engine reads the same copy.
g.text: Single storage layer for every workspace

g.title: ERP database (Database): Operational system of record for orders and customers. Read by a scheduled copy; never written by the platform.
Plant sensors (Device fleet): Field devices that emit temperature and vibration readings every few seconds.
Sales lakehouse (Lakehouse): Raw (bronze) and cleaned (silver) tables for the sales domain, stored as files in the shared lake.
Sales warehouse (Warehouse): Curated (gold) star schema with SQL tables for reporting.
Telemetry store (Event store): Time-partitioned event store optimised for recent-window queries over sensor readings.
Nightly copy (Pipeline): Scheduled pipeline that copies changed ERP rows into the lakehouse raw zone.
Cleaning notebook (Notebook): Spark notebook that deduplicates and types raw tables into silver, then builds gold aggregates.
Sensor stream (Event stream): Event stream that receives device readings, filters them and routes them into the telemetry store.
Sales model (Semantic model): Semantic model: relationships, measures (revenue, margin) and row-level rules over the warehouse.
Query endpoint (API service): Read-only SQL/GraphQL endpoint that exposes curated tables to applications.
Workspace identity (Identity): Single sign-on and workspace roles. Every report, endpoint and item checks it before answering.
Revenue report (Report): Interactive report on the sales model: revenue by region, month and product.
Live dashboard (Live dashboard): Auto-refreshing tiles over the last hour of sensor readings.
Threshold alert (Alert rule): Rule that fires when a reading crosses its threshold and notifies the on-call operator.
Partner web app (Browser client): External web application that reads curated data through the query endpoint.
Analysts (People): Business analysts who explore revenue and share findings.
Operators (People): Plant operators who watch live readings and respond to alerts.

g.text: SYNTHETIC illustration of a Fabric-like platform. Generic names, no logos; not a vendor reference architecture or a real tenant.
